mapper.sql: SELECT ct.claim_id, ct.cause_standard, ct.effect_standard, COUNT(*) AS record_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pct.paper_id) AS paper_count, COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(pct.causal_inference_method, '')) AS diversity, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pct.sign_of_impact = 'positive') AS positive_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pct.sign_of_impact = 'negative') AS negative_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pct.sign_of_impact = 'null_efffect' OR pct.sign_of_impact = 'null') AS null_count, COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE pct.sign_of_impact IS NULL OR pct.sign_of_impact NOT IN ('positive', 'negative', 'null_efffect', 'null') ) AS mixed_count FROM claim_table ct JOIN paper_claim_table pct ON pct.claim_id = ct.claim_id

SELECT ct.claim_id, ct.cause_standard, ct.effect_standard, COUNT(DISTINCT pct.record_id) AS record_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pct.paper_id) AS paper_count, COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(pct.causal_inference_method, '')) AS diversity, COUNT(DISTINCT pct.record_id) FILTER (WHERE pct.sign_of_impact = 'positive') AS positive_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pct.record_id) FILTER (WHERE pct.sign_of_impact = 'negative') AS negative_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pct.record_id) FILTER (WHERE pct.sign_of_impact = 'null_efffect' OR pct.sign_of_impact = 'null') AS null_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pct.record_id) FILTER ( WHERE pct.sign_of_impact IS NULL OR pct.sign_of_impact NOT IN ('positive', 'negative', 'null_efffect', 'null') ) AS mixed_count, COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(wt.subfield_name, '')) AS subfield_count, COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(wt.topic_name, '')) AS topic_count, MIN(w.publication_year) AS year_min, MAX(w.publication_year) AS year_max, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT NULLIF(pct.causal_inference_method, ''), '||') AS methods_text FROM claim_table ct JOIN paper_claim_table pct ON pct.claim_id = ct.claim_id LEFT JOIN work w ON w.work_id = pct.paper_id LEFT JOIN work_topic wt ON wt.work_id = pct.paper_id

SELECT pct.record_id, pct.paper_id AS work_id, w.title, w.publication_year, ( SELECT ws.source_id FROM work_source ws WHERE ws.work_id = pct.paper_id ORDER BY ws.source_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS source_id, ( SELECT s.source_name FROM work_source ws JOIN source s ON s.source_id = ws.source_id WHERE ws.work_id = pct.paper_id ORDER BY ws.source_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS source_name, ( SELECT wt.topic_name FROM work_topic wt WHERE wt.work_id = pct.paper_id ORDER BY wt.topic_name ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1 ) AS topic_name, ( SELECT wt.subfield_name FROM work_topic wt WHERE wt.work_id = pct.paper_id ORDER BY wt.subfield_name ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1 ) AS subfield_name, ct.claim_id, pct.claim, pct.cause, pct.effect, ct.cause_standard, ct.effect_standard, pct.sign_of_impact, pct.type_of_relationship, pct.causal_inference_method, pct.evidence_method_other_description, pct.is_main_contribution, pct.level_of_tentativeness, pct.sources_of_exogenous_variation, pct.statistical_significance, pct.cause_score, pct.effect_score, pct.evidence FROM paper_claim_table pct JOIN claim_table ct ON ct.claim_id = pct.claim_id LEFT JOIN work w ON w.work_id = pct.paper_id
mapper.select: WITH edge_counts AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT claim_id, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM paper_claim_table GROUP BY claim_id ), eligible_edges AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT claim_id FROM edge_counts WHERE record_count >= #{minRecordCount} ), graph_variables AS ( SELECT ct.cause_standard AS variable FROM claim_table ct JOIN eligible_edges ee ON ee.claim_id = ct.claim_id UNION SELECT ct.effect_standard AS variable FROM claim_table ct JOIN eligible_edges ee ON ee.claim_id = ct.claim_id ), all_variables AS ( SELECT cause_standard AS variable FROM claim_table UNION SELECT effect_standard AS variable FROM claim_table ), claim_total AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM claim_table ) SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(record_count), 0) FROM edge_counts) AS total_claim_records, (SELECT count FROM claim_total) AS total_standard_claims, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT paper_id) FROM paper_claim_table) AS total_papers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM all_variables) AS total_nodes, (SELECT count FROM claim_total) AS total_edges, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM graph_variables) AS graph_nodes, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eligible_edges) AS graph_edges
SELECT DISTINCT subfield_name FROM work_topic WHERE subfield_name IS NOT NULL AND subfield_name != '' ORDER BY subfield_name ASC
SELECT DISTINCT causal_inference_method FROM paper_claim_table WHERE causal_inference_method IS NOT NULL AND causal_inference_method != '' ORDER BY causal_inference_method ASC
WHERE ct.claim_id = #{claimId} GROUP BY ct.claim_id, ct.cause_standard, ct.effect_standard

SELECT COALESCE(wt.subfield_name, '未标注') AS name, COUNT(DISTINCT pct.record_id) AS count FROM paper_claim_table pct JOIN claim_table ct ON ct.claim_id = pct.claim_id LEFT JOIN work_topic wt ON wt.work_id = pct.paper_id WHERE ct.cause_standard = #{variable} OR ct.effect_standard = #{variable} GROUP BY COALESCE(wt.subfield_name, '未标注') ORDER BY count DESC, name ASC

SELECT COALESCE(w.publication_year::text, '未知') AS name, COUNT(DISTINCT pct.record_id) AS count FROM paper_claim_table pct JOIN claim_table ct ON ct.claim_id = pct.claim_id LEFT JOIN work w ON w.work_id = pct.paper_id WHERE ct.cause_standard = #{variable} OR ct.effect_standard = #{variable} GROUP BY COALESCE(w.publication_year::text, '未知') ORDER BY name ASC
WHERE pct.paper_id = #{workId} ORDER BY pct.record_id ASC

SELECT variable, SUM(count) AS occurrences FROM ( SELECT ct.cause_standard AS variable, COUNT(pct.record_id) AS count FROM claim_table ct JOIN paper_claim_table pct ON pct.claim_id = ct.claim_id WHERE LOWER(ct.cause_standard) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{query}), '%') GROUP BY ct.cause_standard UNION ALL SELECT ct.effect_standard AS variable, COUNT(pct.record_id) AS count FROM claim_table ct JOIN paper_claim_table pct ON pct.claim_id = ct.claim_id WHERE LOWER(ct.effect_standard) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{query}), '%') GROUP BY ct.effect_standard ) hits GROUP BY variable ORDER BY occurrences DESC, variable ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT label_en FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT label_en FROM stw_label WHERE LOWER(label_en) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{query}), '%') ) candidates ORDER BY CASE WHEN LOWER(label_en) LIKE CONCAT(LOWER(#{query}), '%') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, label_en ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT w.work_id, w.title, w.publication_year, ( SELECT s.source_name FROM work_source ws JOIN source s ON s.source_id = ws.source_id WHERE ws.work_id = w.work_id ORDER BY ws.source_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS source_name, COUNT(pct.record_id) AS claim_record_count FROM work w JOIN paper_claim_table pct ON pct.paper_id = w.work_id WHERE LOWER(w.work_id) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{query}), '%') OR LOWER(w.title) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{query}), '%') GROUP BY w.work_id, w.title, w.publication_year ORDER BY claim_record_count DESC, w.publication_year DESC NULLS LAST, w.work_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT #{workId} AS work_id, COUNT(pct.record_id) AS claim_record_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pct.claim_id) AS standard_claim_count, COUNT(DISTINCT variable) AS variable_count FROM paper_claim_table pct JOIN claim_table ct ON ct.claim_id = pct.claim_id CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( VALUES (ct.cause_standard), (ct.effect_standard) ) AS variables(variable) WHERE pct.paper_id = #{workId}

WITH paper_claim_counts AS ( SELECT pct.paper_id, COUNT(*) AS claim_record_count FROM paper_claim_table pct GROUP BY pct.paper_id ), paper_fields AS ( SELECT DISTINCT pcc.paper_id, COALESCE(wt.subfield_name, '未标注') AS subfield, COALESCE(wt.topic_name, '未标注') AS topic FROM paper_claim_counts pcc LEFT JOIN work_topic wt ON wt.work_id = pcc.paper_id ), field_variable_counts AS ( SELECT variables.subfield, variables.topic, COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(variables.variable), '')) AS variable_count FROM ( SELECT pf.subfield, pf.topic, ct.cause_standard AS variable FROM paper_fields pf JOIN paper_claim_table pct ON pct.paper_id = pf.paper_id JOIN claim_table ct ON ct.claim_id = pct.claim_id UNION ALL SELECT pf.subfield, pf.topic, ct.effect_standard AS variable FROM paper_fields pf JOIN paper_claim_table pct ON pct.paper_id = pf.paper_id JOIN claim_table ct ON ct.claim_id = pct.claim_id ) variables GROUP BY variables.subfield, variables.topic ) SELECT pf.subfield, pf.topic, SUM(pcc.claim_record_count) AS claim_record_count, COUNT(*) AS paper_count, COALESCE(fvc.variable_count, 0) AS variable_count FROM paper_fields pf JOIN paper_claim_counts pcc ON pcc.paper_id = pf.paper_id LEFT JOIN field_variable_counts fvc ON fvc.subfield = pf.subfield AND fvc.topic = pf.topic GROUP BY pf.subfield, pf.topic, fvc.variable_count ORDER BY claim_record_count DESC, subfield ASC, topic ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(pct.causal_inference_method), ''), '未标注方法') AS name, COUNT(DISTINCT pct.record_id) AS count FROM paper_claim_table pct GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(pct.causal_inference_method), ''), '未标注方法') ORDER BY count DESC, name ASC

WITH variables AS ( SELECT ct.cause_standard AS variable, pct.record_id FROM paper_claim_table pct JOIN claim_table ct ON ct.claim_id = pct.claim_id UNION ALL SELECT ct.effect_standard AS variable, pct.record_id FROM paper_claim_table pct JOIN claim_table ct ON ct.claim_id = pct.claim_id ) SELECT variable AS name, COUNT(DISTINCT record_id) AS count FROM variables WHERE variable IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(variable) != '' GROUP BY variable ORDER BY count DESC, name ASC

SELECT ct.cause_standard AS cause, ct.effect_standard AS effect, COUNT(DISTINCT pct.record_id) AS claim_record_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pct.paper_id) AS paper_count, COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(pct.causal_inference_method), '')) AS method_count FROM paper_claim_table pct JOIN claim_table ct ON ct.claim_id = pct.claim_id GROUP BY ct.claim_id, ct.cause_standard, ct.effect_standard ORDER BY claim_record_count DESC, method_count DESC, paper_count DESC, cause ASC, effect ASC
